posts.text:
My hot take is I actually think it's good that the USA can run experiments like this in individual cities and states without tanking the entire country in the process...

This is democracy and decentralisation in action. The people of NYC will get what they voted for.
posts.summary: Defends federalism and local policy experimentation over centralized control

If the city-run discount grocery stores in NYC turn out to be the best thing that's happened to the city in decades, then I will publicly say so.

I will not delete this post, so you can remind me. 

Let's check back in 2 years and see how it pans out.

posts.text:
It's wild seeing people advocating for more and more taxes. A tax on every asset and action, even those that are already taxed.

Meanwhile, I think they should all be abolished...

Say what you want, but I'm grateful to live in a place where my view is the popular one.
posts.summary: Opposes taxes, advocates for abolition of all taxation
